routes.name: Global Servers
routes.empty_state: No servers configured; remote-member failure remains a distinct warning.
routes.local_behavior: Always renders current local server records.
routes.remote_behavior: Renders live records or age-bounded cached records marked unavailable.

routes.name: Deployment
routes.empty_state: Server pills can be empty while create controls remain available.
routes.local_behavior: Creates and lists local servers using public-main behavior.
routes.remote_behavior: Coordinator node selection is shown only from source-backed cluster state.

routes.name: Ports
routes.empty_state: Table body can be empty without hiding refresh or save actions.
routes.local_behavior: Shows editable local game and query ports.
routes.remote_behavior: Coordinator may show signed member-provided ports; unavailable members remain visible through server-view warnings.

routes.name: Cluster
routes.empty_state: No discovered clusters and no members have explicit empty messages.
routes.local_behavior: Shows source-backed create, join, leave, disband, and break controls.
routes.remote_behavior: Member and discovery state is loaded through signed/public cluster endpoints.

routes.name: Panel Users
routes.empty_state: Empty users, login attempts, blocked IPs, and audit output render independently.
routes.local_behavior: Administers the authoritative local panel user store.
routes.remote_behavior: Existing signed cluster synchronization remains unchanged.

routes.name: Discord
routes.empty_state: Not configured and stopped states remain explicit.
routes.local_behavior: Controls the local source-backed Discord bot.
routes.remote_behavior: No provider or remote orchestration behavior is inferred.

routes.name: About
routes.empty_state: Branding controls render with default values when no customization exists.
routes.local_behavior: Describes and configures public-main panel behavior.

routes.name: Server Overview
routes.empty_state: Unknown server IDs return the recoverable global server list.
routes.remote_behavior: Targets the URL-selected signed remote server or cached unavailable marker.

routes.name: Operations
routes.empty_state: Forms remain available and report source-backed command failures.
routes.remote_behavior: Uses the existing signed proxy for the URL-selected remote server.

routes.name: Players
routes.empty_state: No connected players produces an empty player-pill list.
routes.local_behavior: Moderation commands target the selected local server.
routes.remote_behavior: Existing signed proxy behavior targets the selected remote server.

routes.name: Moderation
routes.empty_state: Unavailable or absent moderation configuration is reported explicitly.
routes.local_behavior: Reads and writes the selected local source-backed configuration.
routes.remote_behavior: Uses signed public-source cluster paths only.

routes.name: Settings
routes.empty_state: Missing values render as blank/default controls without choosing another server.
routes.local_behavior: Loads and mutates only the URL-selected local server.
routes.remote_behavior: Uses existing signed cluster paths and exposes remote failures.

routes.name: NoBlackBox
routes.empty_state: Not installed and missing configuration states remain explicit.
routes.local_behavior: Uses the selected local installation and configuration.
routes.remote_behavior: Uses only the signed member behavior present in public source.

routes.name: Gallery
routes.empty_state: No recordings produces an empty file list with status text.
routes.local_behavior: Lists recordings for the selected local server.
routes.remote_behavior: Uses the existing signed fetch/cache path for the selected remote server.

routes.name: Login
routes.empty_state: No error renders the normal login form.
routes.local_behavior: Authenticates against the local authoritative user store.

routes.name: First-run setup
routes.empty_state: No error renders required username and password controls.
routes.local_behavior: Updates the authenticated local bootstrap account.
routes.remote_behavior: No remote/provider setup flow is inferred.
